Samples of the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm's conformance tests (UAX #9): every 40th case of `BidiCharacterTest.txt` and every 60th of `BidiTest.txt` (with all of its `@Levels` and `@Reorder` lines), from the Unicode Character Database, under the Unicode License (https://www.unicode.org/terms_of_use.html). `BidiTest` in `tests/Unit` runs them; the full files pass too (`php tests/fixtures/bidi/full.php <dir with the full files>`).
